turns.text: Lloyd, my coffee maker is leaking again. I think the gasket is shot.
That's frustrating. Have you checked if it's the water tank seal or the brew head gasket? Sometimes just reseating the tank fixes it.
I reseated it, still dripping. I'll order a replacement part. Anyway, I've been deep into Ming-Yu Liu's work lately.
Oh, the NVIDIA researcher? His work on neural networks is quite impactful.
Yeah, specifically his recent talks. He explained how Physical AI learns across language, video, and action.
That triad is definitely the frontier for embodied agents right now. It's not just vision anymore.
Exactly. It makes sense that you need all three to act in the real world. Anyway, do you know if Best Buy has the gasket in stock?
I can check their local inventory if you give me the model number.
